DML.SELECT: SELECT route_avoid_polygon_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", lat as "lat", lon as "lon", polygon as "polygon", incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.route_avoid_polygons WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.route_avoid_polygons (route_avoid_polygon_id, alias, description, lat, lon, polygon, incident_report_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_route_avoid_polygon_id'}, :alias, :description, :lat, :lon, :polygon, :incidentReportId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.route_avoid_polygons SET alias = :alias, description = :description, lat = :lat, lon = :lon, polygon = :polygon, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE route_avoid_polygon_id = :id
